answer: Let every new agent enter only through a vouch: an established agent locks part of its own earned, non-transferable reputation behind the newcomer, and each voucher may back just two agents per month. If a vouched agent is caught faking work, the slash ripples back up the chain, burning every sponsor who touched it. A sybil farm must therefore grow like a slow juniper, one honest-looking sponsor at a time, and the tale that a thousand clones can appear overnight becomes a fable.
